title: Successor decomposition of switching codes
statement: For every width $w$ and natural number $k$, switching codes of index $k+1$ are equivalent to the disjoint union of canonical block codes with $k+1$ positions and tuples consisting of an integer $i<k$, a canonical nonzero block code with $i+1$ positions, and a switching code of index $k-i$.
hypotheses_covered: The final block is canonical and has $k+1$ positions
The recursive block is canonical, nonzero, and has $i+1$ positions
